iti94:2.1: (Tik. V.) Tathā tathā bhikkhave bhikkhu upaparikkheyya, yathā yathā upaparikkhato bahiddhā cassa viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ hoti avisaṭaṃ ajjhattaṃ asaṇṭhitaṃ {anupādāya na paritasseyya} anupādāya aparitassato āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇadukkhasamudayasambhavo na hotīti. Sattasaṅgapahīnassa netticchinnassa bhikkhuno |
iti94:3.1: vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro natthi tassa punabbhavo ti ||5||
